GrownWoodBlock:0.Description: Wood converted into its Grown variant by the Dawn Daisy.

SunPowerFlower:0.Description: Burns fuel thrown onto it to produce Mana.

ThornyRoseFlower:0.Description: A guardian that pricks nearby creatures with mana-driven thorns (players are spared); draws from mana pools on its own when unlinked.

ManaPoolBlock:0.Description: Stores up to 3800 Mn. Drops Items will be convert.

ManaBlock:0.Description: A solid block of Mana-infused steel.
